decisions.title: 7-crate Rust workspace
decisions.reason: Separation of concerns: core/db/services/api/ai/cache/common
decisions.impact: All new code follows this crate layout

decisions.title: CRUD + audit log over Event Sourcing
decisions.reason: Faster initial dev velocity, switch when stable
decisions.impact: Domain events table exists but not primary write path

decisions.title: AI as visible user feature
decisions.reason: Chat assistant, not just backend inference
decisions.impact: Frontend needs AI chat component from day 1

decisions.title: GNU toolchain for Windows build
decisions.reason: MSVC linker missing; GNU toolchain compiles cleanly
decisions.impact: backend/rust-toolchain.toml pins stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu

decisions.title: SQLite for local dev, PostgreSQL for production
decisions.reason: PostgreSQL 14 is running locally but superuser credentials are unknown; SeaORM supports both backends
decisions.impact: DB URL switches via .env; migrations must stay compatible with both SQLite and PostgreSQL

decisions.title: New web/ SolidJS app replaces old frontend attempts
decisions.reason: Old frontend and frontend_new are legacy reference code; clean web/ has SolidJS + UnoCSS + TanStack Query
decisions.impact: All new UI work lives in web/; old frontend directories stay untouched as reference

decisions.title: Local upload storage before MinIO
decisions.reason: MinIO is not running locally; uploads dir + ServeDir gives identical API surface
decisions.impact: UploadResult.url is stable; swap storage layer later without changing UI

decisions.title: AI chat with local fallback + OpenAI-compatible upstream
decisions.reason: Works immediately without a key; set OPENAI_API_KEY/BASE_URL/MODEL to switch to a real LLM
decisions.impact: POST /api/v1/ai/chat returns mode local|llm; UI stays identical

decisions.title: Works persisted in SQLite/Postgres, no localStorage
decisions.reason: Uploaded files were only browser-local; now stored in works table and listed publicly
decisions.impact: POST/GET /api/v1/works; dashboard and home read the same source

decisions.title: Borrow shadcn token/variant patterns for SolidJS
decisions.reason: React shadcn/Vercel templates can't be copied directly; adapt their design tokens and cva variant model into SolidJS + UnoCSS
decisions.impact: ui/ component library is the single source of truth for styling

decisions.title: Appointment state machine + overlap detection
decisions.reason: Enforce pending->confirmed->ongoing->completed with cancellations; reject overlapping slots per creator
decisions.impact: Single source of truth in appointment_service; SQLite dev, Postgres prod

decisions.title: Seed real demo data + work categories
decisions.reason: Replace smoke-test garbage with 8 creators, 8 services, 20 categorized works using 22 real Unsplash photos
decisions.impact: Seed is idempotent; smoke tests must later use an isolated DB

decisions.title: Three role interfaces with seeded login accounts
decisions.reason: admin/customer/creators each get a loginable account and a dedicated surface; login routes by role
decisions.impact: Passwords: admin/admin123, customer/customer123, creators/creator123

decisions.title: Payment escrow + 10% commission settlement
decisions.reason: Balance payment moves appointment to confirmed; creator completion triggers settlement with platform 10% commission
decisions.impact: Escrow recorded in payments table; incomes verified in full-flow E2E

decisions.title: Withdrawal funds freeze on application
decisions.reason: Prevents creators from spending the same balance while an admin review is pending; rejection restores the frozen amount atomically
decisions.impact: withdrawals are pending/completed/rejected; approval records completion, rejection refunds to user balance

decisions.title: Best-effort in-app notifications
decisions.reason: Notification delivery must not roll back an already successful appointment, payment, or withdrawal operation
decisions.impact: Business routes call NotificationService after state changes; insert failures are logged without changing the primary API result

decisions.title: Grouped frontend layouts with route-level guards
decisions.reason: Account, creator, and admin pages duplicated headers and performed request-failure-based redirects; public pages also carried their own navigation shell
decisions.impact: web routes are grouped into public/customer/creator/admin layouts; AppShell owns navigation, notification, user menu, and mobile behavior; RequireAuth handles session hydration and RequireRole handles admin authorization before page render; creator onboarding remains available to authenticated customers until capabilities become a first-class role model

decisions.title: List pagination contract
decisions.reason: PaginatedResponse is used for paginated public list APIs while legacy array helpers remain for older pages
decisions.impact: New list screens use explicit page APIs and existing home/work/profile consumers stay compatible

decisions.title: Role capabilities are computed by auth service
decisions.reason: Admin, customer, and creator access should be declared by the server instead of inferred from a creator list query in the frontend.
decisions.impact: UserDto now includes roles for register/login/me; frontend guards and menus use role capabilities; raw role remains for JWT and admin middleware compatibility. Pure customers keep a Become Creator entry, and profile creation invalidates me so the capability upgrades without re-login.

decisions.title: Security boundaries fail closed
decisions.reason: Public defaults and read-before-write checks allowed privilege forgery and duplicate financial side effects.
decisions.impact: JWT_SECRET is mandatory and strong; AI chat is authenticated and bounded; withdrawal review uses a conditional state transition with Postgres row locking; disabled users are rejected on every authenticated request; public DTOs expose only public fields.
